headline: Rain Expected Through the Weekend
text:
Rain Expected Through the Weekend

Analysts described the decision as a compromise that leaves almost everyone partly satisfied and partly frustrated. Ticket sales have been strong, and organizers say they expect a larger crowd than last year. Officials emphasized that no final decision has been made and that additional hearings will be scheduled. The announcement follows months of quiet negotiations between the agency and neighborhood groups. The forecast calls for rain through the weekend, with a chance of clearing by Monday morning.
